promotion_rule: Registry entries never auto-activate implementation. Activation requires explicit authored stage/tranche authority and a bounded task contract.

themes.title: Product telemetry foundation
themes.activation_gate: Only extend telemetry when a defined consumer, metric, privacy class and retention policy exist.

themes.title: Retention & user-value loops
themes.activation_gate: Promote only when persistent user intent and measurable return value justify additional retention scope.

themes.title: Demand intelligence & zero-result recovery
themes.activation_gate: Sufficient zero-result volume or unresolved demand clusters must demonstrate a measurable product/data gap.

themes.title: Data quality & trust intelligence
themes.activation_gate: Demonstrated completeness, freshness, conflict or duplicate pressure must justify a prioritized quality loop.

themes.title: Provider evidence & quota economy
themes.activation_gate: Provider call volume, quota pressure, upstream failures or avoidable refresh cost must be measurable before expansion.

themes.title: Snapshot & client/edge reuse
themes.activation_gate: A read-heavy surface must demonstrate repeated computation, latency or delivery pressure before new snapshot/edge scope is activated.

themes.title: Acquisition & SEO feedback loop
themes.activation_gate: Real crawl/index/query/CTR evidence must identify the next acquisition bottleneck after launch.

themes.title: Operator cockpit & decision intelligence
themes.activation_gate: Operational signals must be numerous enough that a prioritized unified action queue reduces measurable operator effort.

themes.title: Internal/product AI
themes.activation_gate: A bounded internal task must show measurable ROI over deterministic/structured retrieval before model dependency expands.

themes.title: Governed intelligence & adaptive assistance
themes.activation_gate: Telemetry, outcome feedback, guardrails and rollback/degradation paths must all be accepted before adaptive automation expands.
